standard_prerequisites.name: The characterisation of monomorphisms of algebraic stacks through full faithfulness, and the description of the inertia stack through objects together with their automorphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 1495-1498) as pointers to the chapter on properties of stacks and to the chapter on categories
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns an object of the inertia into a pair and lets automorphisms of the source be identified with automorphisms of the image.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of objects of a fibre product of stacks over a scheme as triples consisting of objects and an isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the end of the counted proof (source lines 1505-1509)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the objects computed in the proof with objects of the fibre product appearing in the statement.

core_obligations: Describe the inertia: an object of the inertia of the source over a scheme is the same as a pair consisting of an object and an automorphism of it in the fibre category (proof lines 1499-1502)
Use full faithfulness: since the morphism is fully faithful, such an automorphism is the same as an automorphism of the image object in the fibre category of the target (proof lines 1502-1504)

Identify with the fibre product: the proof rewrites the resulting data as triples consisting of an object of the target with an automorphism and an isomorphism from it to the image, which are exactly the objects of the fibre product in the statement (proof lines 1505-1509)
proof_roadmap: I_X(T) 的对象就是「X 在 T 上的对象 x 连同自同构 α: x → x」；因 f 全忠实，α 等同于 f(x) 的自同构 β。
于是 I_X(T) 的对象可写成三元组 ((y,β), x, γ)（γ: y ≅ f(x)），这正是 I_Y ×_Y X 的对象，故方块是纤维积。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a monomorphism of algebraic stacks the square relating the inertia of the source, the source, the inertia of the target and the target is a fibre product square (author lemma at source lines 1479-1492, label lemma-monomorphism-cartesian-square-inertia). The proof (source lines 1494-1510) unfolds the inertia into pairs of an object and an automorphism, uses full faithfulness of the monomorphism to transport automorphisms to the image object, and rewrites the result as triples, which are exactly the objects of the fibre product in the statement (proof lines 1499-1509). The triple description is the content. H2.
